title: Behavioral genomics identifies Creld1 as a cross-modal regulator of somatosensation
title_zh: 行为基因组学鉴定Creld1为跨模态体感调节因子
abstract: Somatosensation is mediated by dorsal root ganglion (DRG) neurons, which convert physical and chemical stimuli into electrical signals. However, the full repertoire of molecular components underlying somatosensation remains incompletely identified. Here we developed an efficient postnatal CRISPR-Cas9 knockout platform for interrogating DRG-expressed genes (such as Piezo2, Trpv1 and Scn9a) in mice using AAV9-mediated single-guide RNA delivery. Combining this approach with somatosensory behavioral assays, we performed a targeted screen of 20 genes and identified Creld1 as a cross-model regulator of somatosensation. Either single-guide RNA-mediated postnatal knockout or tamoxifen-induced Cre-mediated deletion of Creld1 in DRG neurons resulted in profound behavioral deficits in touch, temperature, pain and itch, whereas its overexpression enhanced touch and thermal responses. Mechanistically, CRELD1 functions as an auxiliary regulator of voltage-gated sodium channels (Nav) for controlling DRG neuron excitability. Together, this work establishes a robust postnatal screening platform for behavioral genomics and identifies Creld1 as a master regulator of somatosensory function.
abstract_zh: 体感由脊神经节（DRG）神经元介导，这些神经元将物理和化学刺激转化为电信号。然而，介导体感的完整分子成分仍未完全识别。在此，我们开发了一种高效的产后CRISPR-Cas9敲除平台，用于在小鼠中敲除DRG表达的基因（如Piezo2、Trpv1和Scn9a），方法是通过AAV9介导的单导RNA递送。通过将此方法与体感行为测定相结合，我们对20个基因进行了靶向筛选，并鉴定出Creld1作为体感的跨模态调节因子。无论是产后单导RNA介导的敲除还是在DRG神经元中诱导的Cre介导的Creld1删除，均导致触觉、温度、疼痛和瘙痒方面的深刻行为缺陷，而其过表达则增强了触觉和热敏反应。机制上，CRELD1作为电压门控钠通道（Nav）的辅助调节因子，控制DRG神经元的兴奋性。总之，这项工作建立了一个稳健的产后行为基因组学筛选平台，并鉴定Creld1为体感功能的主调节因子。
